// ============================================================
// Storefront: the application's navigation and logo
//
// A customer-facing shop: a light top navigation (the module also states its own topbar), the shopper's pages in the sidebar.
// The logo is the SVG in assets/logos/storefront.svg, inlined as a data URI (tools/embed-logos.py regenerates the line): Studio and Stage take
// a Screenplay document only, never a file beside it, and a data URI cannot 404.
// ============================================================

layout StorefrontNavigation
  category Shell
  content

  navigation topbar
    logo image "data:image/svg+xml;base64," title "Acme Shop"
    item browse title "Browse" target Shop.Browse
    item basket title "Basket" icon shopping-cart target Shop.Basket
    item myorders title "My orders" target Shop.MyOrders
    item account title "Account" target Shop.Account

  navigation sidebar
    item shop title "Shop" icon shopping-cart target Shop
      item browse title "Browse" target Shop.Browse
      item basket title "Basket" target Shop.Basket
      item checkout title "Checkout" target Shop.Checkout
      item myorders title "My orders" target Shop.MyOrders
      item account title "Account" target Shop.Account
